paragraphs: AI: "A fateful turning point for humanity and AI could redefine American politics" (CNN) leads the coverage. Also notable: "We greet the news that AI could extinguish us with a glazed indifference. What is the way out of this nihilism?" (The Guardian).

Political: "Peers to debate donations law changes after Reform's £72m windfall" (BBC News) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Rise in abuse of election candidates is ‘changing politics’ in England" (The Guardian).

Economic: "Gold dips as hot US inflation boosts Fed hike odds" (Briefs Finance) leads the coverage. Also notable: "One Nation vows to cut migration by 750,000 amid warnings move would damage economy" (The Guardian).

Financial: "Europe’s Fractured Stock Market Finally Gets a Single Data Feed" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "South Korea’s $1.4 Trillion National Pension Fund Picks New CIO" (Bloomberg).

Geopolitical: "Bank of England’s Dovish Majority Tested by Iran War Pressures" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Politics live: petrol prices set to rise ‘even higher’; Labor’s private health reform for over-65s condemned as ‘lazy’" (The Guardian).
